# Results report (generated by analysis/write-report.R)

Arms: reml_model / ncv_model = model-based intervals of the REML / NCV fit; *_cl2 = curve-clustered CL2 (Bayesian form); ncv_cl2_bias = NCV + CL2 + bias allowance (the pre-specified proposal); ncv_cl2f_bias = the same with the frequentist CL2; ar1_model = AR(1) working model. Coverage is the grid average, nominal 0.95. Intervals in brackets are 95% replicate-bootstrap intervals.

Cells: 123; tasks scored: 24600; failed tasks: 0.
